Jordan: FYI customer ask — EU fintech POC needs SOC2 + ISO artifacts, presigned upload for staging, and a signed pen-test letter from our vendor. Kickoff next week. cc @Kim @Sasha
Kim: Which exact artifacts do they want? SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert, pen-test letter — full report or attestation?
Jordan: They asked for attestation + scoped network diagram. Also presigned S3 for artifact upload and a contact who can sign the pen-test letter (legal/ops).
Sasha: We can provide SOC2 attestation exec summary + ISO cert. Full pen-test report requires redaction. For signing the letter, legal prefers template + signatory: "Redwood Security" ops lead. @Matt can you confirm?
Matt: I can sign the pen-test letter as ops lead. Need the customer's signer name & org. Also presign S3: ops needs a ticket with duration + exact bucket path.
Jordan: Customer is NordicPayments AB, signer is CISO Erik Lind. They want a presigned URL valid 72h to upload ~800MB zip. They also asked that we do NOT share any KMS scanning creds.
Kim: 72h presign ok. I'll generate a presigned URL scoped to a single path and put lifecycle = 7d. Matt — confirm redaction policy? we'll only share Exec Summary PDF + remediation attestation, not raw vuln output.
Matt: Ack. We'll provide exec summary PDF, ISO cert PDF, and signed pen-test letter. Redacted sections replaced with [REDACTED]. Legal will review wording.
sec-bot: pen-test-letter-template.pdf uploaded to /shared/evidence/pen-tests/1769123456-template.pdf
Sasha: Jordan — please get Erik's email to route the signature and confirm whether notarization is required.
Jordan: Erik email: erik.lind@nordicpay.com. They mentioned notarization as nice-to-have but attestation is acceptable. I'll confirm if they require a corporate stamp.
Kim: :thumbsup: I'll create the presigned URL and post the link here when ready. ETA ~2h.
Matt: I'll draft the pen-test signing letter using the template and route to legal for approval. ETA EOD today.
Jordan: Thanks — sample scope they asked to include for the letter:
```
- scope: production + staging endpoints
- timeframe: last 12 months
- remediation statement confirming fixes applied or compensating controls
```
I'll update thread once legal signs off.
Sasha: One more customer question — can Redwood offer a short-term on-prem Dedicated POC for data residency? that's separate from evidence but could affect pricing. @Jordan can you follow up?
Jordan: Noted, I'll open a dedicated thread for Dedicated/on-prem pricing and capacity. Closing this thread once artifacts + signed letter posted.
